description: Find anime and manga, see what’s airing and read your Shikimori watchlist.

shikimori_new_watchlist_entry_trigger.description: Runs for each new Shikimori watchlist entry in Shikimori. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, user_id, target_id, target_type, status, score, episodes, chapters, volumes, rewatches, created_at, updated_at

parameters.description: Shikimori user ID from Get your Shikimori profile.
parameters.name: profile_id

shikimori_watchlist_entry_updated_trigge.description: Runs each time a shikimori watchlist entry changes in Shikimori. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, user_id, target_id, target_type, status, score, episodes, chapters, volumes, rewatches, created_at, updated_at

parameters.description: Shikimori user ID from Get your Shikimori profile.
parameters.name: profile_id
